text.formatted: If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
text.plain: If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

text.formatted: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.
text.plain: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +9, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.

text.formatted: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 17, one creature Grappled by the glabrezu. _Failure:_ 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. _Success:_ Half damage.
text.plain: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature Grappled by the glabrezu. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

text.formatted:
The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic
- **1/Day Each:** Confusion, Fly, Power Word Stun
